The BBPS API (Business Processes Payment System Application Programming Interface) is a set of protocols and tools for building software applications that can interact with the BBPS system.

BBPS is an electronic funds transfer system used in India for making various types of financial transactions, such as bill payments, fund transfers, and other similar transactions.

The BBPS API allows developers to build custom software applications that can integrate with the BBPS system and enable users to perform various types of financial transactions using their preferred software application.

Some of the key features and capabilities of the BBPS API include:

* Support for a wide range of payment channels, including KIOSK, AGT, BSC, and others.
* Support for various types of customer parameters, such as CustParam1, CustParam2, and others.
* Support for various types of transaction statuses, such as Pending, Success, Failure, and others.
* Support for various types of error codes and messages, to help developers diagnose and resolve any issues that may arise while using the BBPS API.

Overall, the BBPS API provides a powerful and flexible platform for building custom software applications that can integrate with the BBPS system and enable users to perform various types of financial transactions using their preferred software application.

Bharat BillPay is a standardized bill payment system in India. It enables customers to make bill payments across various industries and sectors such as telecom, electricity, water, gas, insurance, mutual funds, education, health, and others. The system allows customers to make bill payments through multiple channels including self-service channels like internet banking, mobile banking, and other digital channels, assisted channels like branches, agent outlets, and customer service call centers, and electronic and manual modes of payment delivery such as e-wallets, prepaid cards, debit cards, credit cards, net banking, mobile banking, SMS banking, USSD banking, ATM transactions, cheque deposits, cash withdrawals, standing instructions, recurring payments, one-time payments, and others. The system also provides features for billers to manage their bills, receipts, and customer information, as well as features for customers to view, manage, and track their bills, payments, and account information. Overall, Bharat BillPay aims to provide a convenient, efficient, secure, and transparent bill payment system for all stakeholders including customers, billers, banks, financial institutions, regulators, and others.
